verdict: Likely to pass a keyword screen for most core skills, but SQL and BI evidence is thin and 'PostgreSQL', 'dashboard' and 'Tableau' wording is missing.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, CS or related
requirement_coverage.evidence: B.Sc. Industrial Engineering, Marmara Technical University (fictional) — 09/2020 - June 2024

requirement_coverage.requirement: Python (pandas) or R for data analysis
requirement_coverage.evidence: Used Python (pandas) to analyse 2 years of daily sales data from 12 stores.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Experience with a BI tool (Power BI or Tableau)
requirement_coverage.evidence: Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), Python (pandas, matplotlib), SQL (basic), Power BI, Minitab
Responsible for preparing weekly stock reports in Excel.
Presented results to the company's operations manager.

requirement_coverage.requirement: Retail, FMCG or supply chain data experience
requirement_coverage.evidence: Intern, Supply Chain Department — Boğaziçi Gıda A.Ş. (fictional), Istanbul
Graduation Project: Demand Forecasting for a Bakery Chain

requirement_coverage.requirement: Google Data Analytics or similar certificate

strengths.point: Python/pandas is backed by a concrete, retail-like project with real data volume.
strengths.evidence: Used Python (pandas) to analyse 2 years of daily sales data from 12 stores.

strengths.point: Relevant certificate that the posting explicitly lists as a plus.
Supply-chain internship matches the 'retail, FMCG or supply chain data' nice-to-have.
strengths.evidence: Intern, Supply Chain Department — Boğaziçi Gıda A.Ş. (fictional), Istanbul

issues.problem: SQL is a core must-have ('solid SQL skills'), but the CV labels it 'basic' and never shows it used in a project or job. An ATS ranks this as weak or missing.
issues.fix: If you have used SQL (e.g. in the Database Systems course or a project), add one bullet that shows it: what data, which operations (JOIN, GROUP BY) and for what. Remove the word 'basic' only if you can solve typical junior SQL tasks.

issues.evidence: Made a dashboard about Istanbul traffic data.
issues.problem: Power BI appears only in the skills list; the one dashboard project does not name the tool, so the BI must-have is only partially evidenced.
issues.fix: Name the tool and what the dashboard shows, e.g. 'Built a Power BI dashboard …' — only if it was really built in Power BI.

issues.problem: The keywords 'PostgreSQL', 'dashboard' (in an experience bullet) and 'data validation' from the posting do not appear anywhere.
issues.fix: Where truthful, use the posting's wording in your bullets (e.g. 'cleaned and validated supplier data'). Add a keyword only if you genuinely have that skill.

issues.problem: Date formats are mixed ('July 2023', '09/2023', '2021 - 2022'), which can confuse ATS date parsing.
issues.fix: Use one format everywhere, e.g. 'Jul 2023 – Sep 2023'.

issues.problem: Many ATS and recruiters expect a 'Summary' or 'Profile' heading; 'Objective' with generic text adds no keywords.
issues.fix: Rename to 'Summary' and include 2–3 posting keywords you can back up (SQL, Power BI, forecasting).
